doc.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015

title: Butch Miles as his first drum teacher
summary: Butch Miles taught him tricks of the trade and technique.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Okay. I guess he felt my energy. And I wasn’t the most technical, and I never have been really the most technical drummer like a Buddy Rich or Butch Miles, who was my teacher when I was growing up for a year. He was my first drum teacher. It was great. He taught me all kinds of stuff. He goes, “you’ve got the time, I just have to teach you the tricks now.” The tricks of the trade. So he did. He showed me all kinds of stuff. And technique, we worked on technique of course.
